CustomField.description: PacPoint-MV032719 - Created for BREG phase 1, Used to identify if the status is "final".
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( AND ( NOT(ISBLANK(Filing__c)), StatusValue__c = "Filing Completed" ), AND ( NOT(ISBLANK(SEBCase__c)), StatusValue__c = "Closed" ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Exam__c)), StatusValue__c = "Exam Completed" ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Investigation__c)), OR( StatusValue__c = "Recommend to Close", StatusValue__c = "Recommend Referral to Legal" ) ) ), true, false)
CustomField.label: Is Final Status?
